caption: The drawing depicts a wrought iron gate with ornate decorative elements, rendered in shades of brown pencil on a plain off-white background. The gate features vertical bars, pointed finials, and intricate scrollwork patterns on each side panel. At the center, there is a prominent vertical section with closely spaced vertical bars flanked by more scrollwork, and above this section, an arched detail is present, radiating lines resembling a sunburst. Extending above the entire gate, a large cross with ornamental ends is supported by symmetrical curling scrolls on both sides. The bottom of the gate includes a horizontal bar decorated with repeating curved motifs, while a blue rectangle at the base suggests a foundation or threshold. The composition is symmetrical, emphasizing the central cross and balanced decorative motifs on both sides.
title: Iron Gate and Fence
